title: AI Search Landscape company record
description: One company or product row in data/ai-search/ or data/ai-agents/. A missing field means not disclosed or not verified, never zero. Every number carries a source URL.

name.description: Display name exactly as published in the study, for example 'Cursor (Anysphere)' or 'OpenAI (Codex)'.

slug.description: File name without .yaml. Lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens.

dataset.description: Which study the row belongs to. Must match the folder the file is in.

company.description: The company entity. Several product rows can share one company; funding is counted once per company.

product.description: Named product line, when the row describes one product of a larger company.

website.description: Bare domain as published, without scheme, for example 'example.com' or 'example.com/agents'.

segment.description: Segment id from schema/vocab/segments.json for this dataset.

hq.description: Headquarters. Legal seat from the company's own Terms, Imprint or Legal Notice first; see METHODOLOGY.md.

source.description: Page that states the headquarters (Terms, Imprint, Legal Notice, About page or press).

public_company.description: True when the company, or the parent that sells the product, is listed on a stock exchange. Public companies carry no funding total.

model_lab.description: True for frontier model labs, which the AI agent study reports apart from every funding total.

funding.description: Disclosed equity funding in US dollars. Totals are minimums: only disclosed, verified rounds count.

bootstrapped.description: True only when a public source states the company raised no outside funding.

source.description: Page that states the round, when it is not funding.source (for example when the total adds several rounds).

total_sources.description: Set when no single page states total_usd: the pages that state each round added into it. Their amounts sum to total_usd.

date_type.description: Whether date is the announcement or the closing of the deal.

price_note.description: Qualifier exactly as published, for example 'about, reported'.

closure.description: Set when status is closed: when the product or company shut down, with a public source.

pricing.description: List price per month as listed by the vendor on its own site, before tax, on the last_verified date.

model.description: Pricing model id from schema/vocab/pricing-models.json (AI agent study only).

sources.description: Every URL the row was checked against. Each field-level source must appear here.

last_verified.description: Date the row was last checked against its sources.
